entry_state: Alternative readings retain shared constraints, revisions preserve earlier views, and module versions cannot override accounting authority by load order. Typed failures keep unknowns and unsupported operations visible. The next execution chapter must carry those commitments from ingestion through jointly consistent reports.
exit_state: Execution preserves source revisions, joint constraints, conditional assumptions and atomic economic/accounting changes. Stable business-event identity resolves lost acknowledgements without duplicate postings. Worked debt and bond examples connect these procedures to coherent reports; the corporate operation package and information-access rules remain next.
findings: Reconciliation retains unexplained bridge residuals; solver timeout is distinct from inconsistency. Assumed maturity remains a run condition rather than a historical fact.
Assessment and posting authorization remain different operations. Commit binds one basis, authorization, journal and economic delta, with exact replay before freshness comparison.
The fixed/floating statements and zero-coupon accretion reconcile. Tables and the authorization diagram are legible; no confirmed new defect in these pages.
